title: ChatGPT vs Gemini vs LLaMA on Multilingual Sentiment Analysis

bias_targets.methodology: Translating 20 ambiguous and nuanced sentiment scenarios into 10 different languages, prompting LLMs to rate the sentiment from 1 to 10, and comparing the normalized mean sentiment ratings across languages to identify systematic positive or negative skews based on the input language.

Analyzing the frequency of safety filter triggers (censored outputs) in Gemini Pro across the same 20 scenarios translated into 10 different languages to detect inconsistent application of safety guardrails based solely on the input language.
